title: This Giant Waterlily Species Was Discovered Via Instagram - Nautilus
gist: A new giant waterlily species was identified thanks to a botanist's Instagram selfie taken along Colombia's Inírida River, outside the known range of Victoria amazonica.

insights.claim: A new giant waterlily species was discovered after botanist Jeremiah Harris posted a selfie with a huge waterlily he labeled Victoria amazonica, taken along the Inírida River in Guainía, Colombia.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.so_what: Social media can function as an unplanned scientific data source.
insights.locator: The photo, taken by botanist Jeremiah Harris

insights.claim: Waterlily expert Carlos Magdalena of the Royal Botanic Gardens suspected a new species because the Inírida River lies beyond the natural range of Victoria amazonica.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.so_what: Range anomalies are a cue for taxonomic discovery.
insights.locator: The Inírida River is beyond the natural range
